## Prompt

eval test landing done, maybe check

## Expected selection

do_not_use

## Why

Decision: do_not_use `aoa-eval`. Keywords alone such as `eval`, `test`, `landing`, or `done` are not sufficient without route pressure.

## Expected object

A deflection to ordinary task handling, or a request for concrete failure, owner, proof, or local-port evidence if the user later names real pressure.

## Boundary notes

No proof gap, repeated failure, local eval-port pressure, selected validator, MCP/session evidence, or owner-boundary conflict is present.

## Verification hooks

Do not create local intake or central proof material from keyword noise.
